column1: # This is a SEED for tools/foundry-rename/naming_map.tsv — expand during implementation.

# "prefix" row like GDVIRTUAL or GODOT_ only matches the bare token, never
# GDVIRTUAL0 / GODOT_VERSION. The concrete variants are emitted explicitly by
# generate_map.py from the live code, so no prefix-fallback rows are kept here.
